isotope_mass.display: 40.4 kg total (27.2 kg enriched to ~88% in 76Ge)
isotope_mass.quote: The arrays operated with up to 40.4 kg of detectors (27.2 kg enriched to ~88% in 76Ge).

summary.plain: Two modular arrays of ultra-pure germanium crystal detectors, kept in vacuum cryostats almost a mile underground in South Dakota, listening for a rare radioactive decay.
summary.technical: Two modules of p-type point-contact HPGe detectors (40.4 kg total, 27.2 kg enriched to ~88% 76Ge) in electroformed-copper vacuum cryostats with a low-background passive/active shield, at the Davis Campus, 4850 Level (1478 m), SURF.

technology.quote: modular arrays of high-purity Ge detectors operated in vacuum cryostats in a low-background shield
